get.description: This endpoint gets a list of scorecards for a given workspace. It supports several filtering options through query params.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the workspace you want to query scorecards for

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Tells the API how to sort the output

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Specfies the property to sort on

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter scorecards that have a start date greater than this date

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter scorecards that have an end date less than this date

parameters.name: creators
parameters.description: Comma separated list of user ids that created the scorecards

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Comma separated list of scorecared statuses

get.description: Provides criteria scores for media if they are available.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Comma separated list of platforms for which to get the media score

message.example: No API media record found for external media ID: example-media-id with source: example-source

post.description: Lets you upload single media asset for scoring against your criteria.

channels.description: List of channels to score media for

workspaceId.description: ID of workspace to include scoring criteria from

message.example: A media entry with id 'example-media-id' and version 'example-version' already exists

get.description: Provides a way to check media scoring status.

status.example: One of [COMPLETE, PROCESSING, UNSUPPORTED, FAILED, ERROR]

message.example: No API media record found for external media ID: example-media-id with source: example-source and version: example-version

post.description: This endpoint provides a list of criteria across all workspaces in an organization along with the organization level criteria.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Pagination parameter to set page size

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination parameter to specify offset from zero.

workspaces.description: Limit response to list of workspace IDs provided. Mutually exclusive with `globalOnly` parameter.

channels.description: Limit response to include criteria from list of channels provided.

consideration.description: Filter criteria by consideration. Accepted values are `MANDATORY` or `OPTIONAL`

criteriaGroups.description: Filter criteria to those belonging to provided list of criteria group UUIDs.

globalOnly.description: Limit response to include only organization level criteria. Mutually exclusive with `workspaces` parameter.

get.description: Fetches a list of metadata objects for media in a given scorecard. When a date range is provided, it applies only to inflight scorecards and retrieves media with impressions within that range. Dates are otherwise disregarded for preflight scorecards.

parameters.name: scorecardId
parameters.description: ID of the scorecard to fetch media metadata for.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Impression start for inflight media—disregarded for preflight. Defaults to 3 months back.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Impression end date—similarly disregarded for preflight. Defaults to current day.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Pagination parameter to set page size.

parameters.name: offSet
parameters.description: Pagination parameter to specify offset from 0.
